summary: Performs a two-input difference composite, with fixed-layer and overlay transform controls before comparison.

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Overlay fit mode: fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitoutside, or nativeres

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Overlay edge behavior: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Fixed Layer does not change input order; it chooses the reference resolution and aspect.
Mismatched timing, resolution, or aspect can look like image difference even when the source content matches.
Transform controls affect only the overlay input.
Use Native Resolution for pixel-accurate comparisons and motion masks.
key_concepts: Difference TOP compares two input images and outputs their pixel difference.
Fixed Layer selects which input controls the default output resolution and aspect.
The non-fixed input is treated as the overlay and can be prefit, justified, extended, and transformed before comparison.
Transform parameters affect only the overlay, not the fixed input or input order.
Native Resolution is useful when frame or image comparisons must stay pixel-accurate.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
